question: Neeraj Chopra won the Ostrava Golden Spike javelin event in June 2025 with what distance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**85.29 m**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The prominent Indian javelin thrower, **Neeraj Chopra**, secured the first position at the **Ostrava Golden Spike** athletics meet.
 
• As per the event records for **June 2025**, he clinched the gold medal with a best throw of **85.29 m**.
 
• The **Ostrava Golden Spike** is a highly prestigious event held annually at the **Mestsky Stadium** in **Ostrava**, **Czech Republic**.
 
• The competition is a key fixture in the **World Athletics Continental Tour Gold** series, attracting the world's top-ranked javelin throwers.
 
• This victory further consolidates his standing as a world-class athlete and serves as a significant milestone in his preparation for the **2025** season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra's Profile**: 
 
 
• He is a **Subedar** in the **Indian Army** and became a national hero after winning the gold medal at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**.
 
• His **Olympic gold** was a historic feat, as he was the first **Indian** to win a track and field gold medal at the **Olympic Games**.
 
• He holds the **National Record** in javelin throw for India with a massive throw of **89.94 m**, achieved at the **Stockholm Diamond League** in **2022**.
 
 
 
• **Major Career Achievements**:
 
 
• **World Athletics Championships**: Neeraj won the **Gold medal** at the **2023 World Championships** in **Budapest** with a throw of **88.17 m**.
 
• **Asian Games**: He secured back-to-back gold medals at the **2018 Jakarta** and **2022 Hangzhou Asian Games**.
 
• **Diamond League**: He became the first **Indian** to win the **Diamond League Final** trophy in **2022**.
 
 
 
• **National Recognitions**:
 
 
• In recognition of his sporting excellence, he was awarded the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna** in **2021**.
 
• He was also conferred with the **Padma Shri**, India's fourth-highest civilian award, in **2022**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Event Significance**: The **Ostrava Golden Spike** meet is one of the oldest and most respected athletics competitions in **Europe**, dating back to **1961**.
 
• **Technical Prowess**: Achieving a throw of **85.29 m** requires immense **explosive power**, **flexibility**, and **aerodynamic precision**. Chopra is known for his exceptional **run-up speed** and **blocking technique**.
 
• **Rivalries**: In such international meets, Neeraj frequently competes against elite athletes like **Jakub Vadlejch** of the **Czech Republic** and **Julian Weber** of **Germany**.
 
• **Global Ranking**: Success in the **Continental Tour Gold** events is vital for securing points in the **World Athletics Rankings**, which determine qualification for **World Championships** and **Olympic Games**.
